page.notes: The word "uo" at the top is a fragment of a word broken from the previous page (probably "auo"/"auo" cut at the line end), kept as printed. The line-end mark after "u" in "cuius u-xor" is read as a hyphen. The abbreviation after "ualitura" is read as -mq; with a doubt, marked [?]. Old-style page number read as 160.
